# Appendix: The Slop Defence Kit {#sec-slop-defence-kit}

The five gates from Chapter 9, as a starting configuration. Tune the thresholds; never remove a gate silently.

| Gate | Tool | Starting threshold |
|---|---|---|
| Style and errors | `ruff check` | any error fails |
| Behaviour | `pytest` | any failure fails |
| Coverage floor | `pytest --cov-fail-under` | 80% |
| Forgotten promises | TODO/FIXME grep | more than 5 fails |
| Change-size budget | `git diff main --stat` | more than 400 lines fails |

## Commissioning prompt

```text
Build slop_check.py implementing the five gates above as one script,
per the specification in this conversation. Under 100 lines,
standard library plus ruff and pytest only.
```

## Wiring

- Local: pre-commit hook running `python slop_check.py`.
- Remote: the same five gates as a CI workflow — commission the YAML
  from the agent, then verify it by opening a branch pull request.
